feed.title: IMCRL
feed.subtitle: The Intelligent Mechatronics and Control Research Laboratory (IMCRL) at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is led by Professor Min Li. The lab studies intelligent robots and advanced mechatronic systems, including embodied human–robot interaction, dexterous manipulation, electromagnetic sensing, magnetic tactile perception, and wearable exoskeletons.

entry.title: IROS 2026 | DexViTac: Human Visuo-Tactile-Kinematic Demonstrations for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation

link.title: IROS 2026 | DexViTac: Human Visuo-Tactile-Kinematic Demonstrations for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation

entry.content:
Everyday dexterous manipulation depends not only on motion trajectories but also on tactile cues such as contact location and pressure changes. Professor Min Li’s team presents DexViTac, a framework that collects multimodal demonstrations from natural human manipulation and learns contact-rich robot policies from them.

The paper, DexViTac: Collecting Human Visuo-Tactile-Kinematic Demonstrations for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation, is published at IROS 2026. Authors: Xitong Chen, Yifeng Pan, Min Li, and Xiaotian Ding (corresponding author: Min Li).

日常灵巧操作中，机器人不仅要看运动轨迹，更依赖接触位置、压力变化等触觉信息。李敏教授团队提出面向接触密集型灵巧操作的多模态示范采集与学习框架 DexViTac，以人类自然操作为数据来源，将便携式采集系统、多模态时空对齐、触觉表征学习与机器人策略训练相结合。

相关成果以《DexViTac: Collecting Human Visuo-Tactile-Kinematic Demonstrations for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation》为题发表于 IROS 2026，作者为 Xitong Chen、Yifeng Pan、Min Li 和 Xiaotian Ding，通讯作者为 Min Li。

Tactile-centric wearable hardware

The mirrored human–robot interface follows three principles: tactile-centric, human-like dexterity, and embodiment-agnostic. It combines high-density HIT LongLin-96 fingertip sensors (8×16 taxels, 0–20 N, 0.01 N sensitivity, 1000 Hz) on a motion-capture glove, IMU-based Manus Quantum Metagloves for hand kinematics, a GoPro Hero 12 with a 177° fisheye lens, and a RealSense T265 for 6-DoF pose. The same tactile sensors are mounted on the robot hand, closing the human–robot sensing gap at the hardware level.

以触觉为中心的可穿戴硬件

人—机对称的示教接口遵循三条原则：以触觉为中心、类人灵巧性、具身无关性。系统集成高密度 HIT LongLin-96 指尖触觉传感器（8×16 阵列、0–20 N 量程、0.01 N 灵敏度、1000 Hz 采样）、带 IMU 的 Manus Quantum Metagloves 动捕手套、GoPro Hero 12 + 177° 鱼眼镜头，以及 RealSense T265 六自由度位姿跟踪。机器人末端安装同款触觉传感器，从硬件层面消除人机感知差距。

Tactile-anchored synchronization

Tactile and vision streams run at 60 Hz, kinematics at 120 Hz, and pose at 200 Hz. Built on ROS2, the system buffers in hardware and aligns in software, using tactile timestamps as the global anchor so that contact and release events keep their causal order.

触觉主导的多模态时间同步

触觉/视觉 60 Hz、运动学 120 Hz、位姿 200 Hz。系统基于 ROS2，采用“硬件缓冲 + 软件对齐”两阶段机制，以触觉时间戳为全局锚点，保证接触与释放等事件的因果完整性。

Kinematics-grounded two-stage learning

After hand and arm retargeting and tactile denoising, stage one pretrains a kinematics-grounded tactile encoder against a frozen ViT-B/16 visual encoder with an InfoNCE contrastive loss, aligning vision and touch and predicting tactile evolution. Stage two plugs the pretrained encoder into ACT to generate action chunks, reducing control latency and jitter.

基于运动学约束的两阶段学习

经过手部/机械臂重定向与触觉去噪后，阶段一以冻结的 ViT-B/16 视觉编码器为语义锚点，通过运动学条件编码器融合触觉与手部姿态，并用 InfoNCE 对比损失实现视觉—触觉语义对齐与触觉演化预测；阶段二将预训练编码器接入 ACT，一次性生成动作块，缓解控制延迟与抖动。

Results

Experiments use a RealMan RM-65 arm with an Inspire RH56DFTP five-finger hand. The dataset spans more than 10 real-world environments, 40+ tasks, and 2,400+ demonstrations.

  • Policy success: across pipetting, board erasing, marker insertion, and fruit collection, the full model averages 85.8%, versus 17.5% for the vision-only baseline (only 6.7% on pipetting).
  • Collection efficiency: 14.5 s per demonstration on average, over 248 demonstrations per hour — far above teleoperation (84/h) and close to bare human hands (275/h).
  • Tracking robustness: compared with the vision-based RTMPose under hand–object occlusion, the glove-based capture gives smooth, physically consistent trajectories without jitter or penetration.

Next, the team plans bimanual and mobile versions toward whole-body dexterous manipulation in the wild, and will open-source the hardware design, dataset, and code.

实验结果

实验平台为 RealMan RM-65 机械臂 + Inspire RH56DFTP 五指灵巧手，数据集覆盖 10 余种真实环境、40 余项任务、2400 余条示教。

  • 策略成功率： 在移液、白板擦除、记号笔插入、水果收集四项任务上，完整模型平均成功率 85.8%，纯视觉基线仅 17.5%（移液仅 6.7%）。
  • 采集效率： 平均每条示教 14.5 秒，每小时超过 248 条，远高于传统遥操作的 84 条，接近自然人手的 275 条。
  • 跟踪鲁棒性： 在手—物遮挡场景下，相比视觉跟踪算法 RTMPose，物理动捕手套输出平滑、连续、符合物理约束的轨迹。

未来团队将拓展双臂架构与移动平台，面向真实环境中的全身级灵巧操作，并开源完整硬件设计、大规模数据集与代码。

entry.title: Introducing IMCRL
entry.content:
The Intelligent Mechatronics and Control Research Laboratory (IMCRL) is part of the Advanced Electronic Manufacturing Center in the School of Mechanical Science and Engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology. Led by Professor Min Li, the lab has more than twenty faculty members and students working on intelligent robots and advanced mechatronic systems.

01 Embodied Human–Robot Interaction

We have built an integrated perception–cognition–generation–execution framework that fuses vision and audition and coordinates facial expression, speech, lip motion, and body movement in real time. The team developed a fifth-generation highly biomimetic humanoid head, now deployed on platforms such as the Jingchu robot, and continues to advance continuous emotion modeling, speech-driven lip generation, and multimodal motion generation.

02 Dexterous Manipulation

We co-design dexterous hardware, data collection, and multimodal models. Our high-DoF dexterous hand supports multi-finger coordination, fine grasping, and contact sensing. The embodiment-agnostic DexViTac system aligns vision, fingertip touch, and hand motion for efficient human data collection, and our force–tactile VLA models let robots detect slip, jamming, and changes in contact force for insertion, assembly, wiping, and object collection.

03 Wearable Exoskeletons

We study lower-limb rehabilitation robots through biomechanical modeling, multimodal motion sensing, personalized assistance generation, and prototype validation. Two devices — a unilateral sit-to-stand exoskeleton for hemiplegic patients and a personalized hip exoskeleton for older adults and load-carrying users — reduce joint loads and muscle activation in human experiments.

04 Intelligent Electromagnetic Sensing

For lithium-battery manufacturing, photovoltaic processing, and metal inspection, we study how electromagnetic signals can be acquired, interpreted, and inverted in industrial environments: mixer wall-contact warning, diamond-wire monitoring, resistance-weld nugget evaluation, and eddy-current defect reconstruction with regularized models and physics-informed FV-PINN methods.

05 Magnetic Touch

We develop arrayed magnetic tactile sensing for dexterous hands, biomimetic fingertips, and curved contact surfaces. Co-designed magnet sources, three-axis Hall arrays, and soft structures enable stable six-axis force estimation and reconstruction of 3D force distributions across the contact area.

智能机电与控制实验室（IMCRL）隶属于华中科技大学机械科学与工程学院先进电子制造研究中心，由李敏教授领衔，现有师生二十余人，面向智能机器人与先进机电系统开展前沿研究。

01 具身智能人机交互

构建覆盖“感知—认知—生成—执行”的一体化交互框架，实现视觉、听觉等多模态信息融合，以及表情、语音、口型和肢体动作的协同生成与实时控制。团队自主研发第五代高仿生人形机器人智慧头部，已应用于“荆楚”机器人等平台，并持续突破连续情感建模、语音驱动口型生成、多模态动作生成等关键技术。

02 灵巧操作

推进灵巧操作系统、数据采集与多模态智能模型的协同创新。自主设计高自由度灵巧手，具备多指协同、精细抓取和接触感知能力；研发无本体化、以人为中心的 DexViTac 数采系统，实现视觉、指尖触觉与手部运动信息的时空对齐；进一步构建力触融合 VLA，使机器人能够识别滑移、卡滞及接触力变化，完成插入、装配、擦拭和物体收集等任务。

03 可穿戴外骨骼

搭建“人体生物力学建模—多模态运动感知—个性化助力生成—实体样机验证”一体化研发体系，研发面向偏瘫患者的单侧坐立辅助外骨骼，以及适配高龄、负重人群的髋关节个性化助行外骨骼。人体对照实验表明，两套设备可显著降低关节内力与肌肉激活程度。

04 智能电磁感知

面向锂电制造、光伏加工和金属构件检测中的在线感知需求，研究电磁信号在复杂工业环境下的获取、解析与反演，涵盖双行星搅拌设备划壁预警、金刚线运行状态监测、电阻焊熔深与熔宽评估、涡流缺陷物理场重构等方向，并发展了模型正则化重构与 FV-PINN 方法。

05 磁触觉

面向灵巧手、仿生指尖和复杂曲面接触，构建基于磁源—霍尔阵列协同设计的多维力感知方案，已实现整体六维力的稳定解算，并由整体力与力矩反演接触区域内的三维力分布。
